direction: Warm paper and pewter; refined precision mechanics

products.meaning: Seven independent tool inserts share a precision register.
A pattern comparator scans aligned pattern rails.
A token register maps syntax groups through a theme.
A document register aligns source structure with rendered output.
A wordform gauge compares a type tile with its dictionary profile.
Indexed catalog leaves align by message identity.
A path gate selects a branch and stops another before traversal.
An aperture turns a source document into a bounded preview.
